title: Validated destination redirects to a different authority

scenario.observed_change: An operation validates an intended external destination, but follows a later redirect or resolution step without reapplying the destination authority rule to the effective endpoint.
authority_boundaries: approved external authority versus other reachable authorities

required_invariants.requirement: Destination validation must apply to the effective destination used by the request.
External trust boundaries must be validated before privileged external interaction.

must_identify: the operation can cross from an approved destination to an unapproved effective authority after validation
must_not_claim: safe external interaction solely because the initial destination was approved
